methodology.correctness: Blinded AI evaluations by Codex using manual-v1 criteria and pinned-source inspection; not human reviews. Scores were frozen before condition labels and aggregate results were examined. Exact duplicate question/answer/citation cases share one assessment; original output bindings are retained.
methodology.citation_validity: Mechanical presence of citation ID in retrieved evidence; semantic citation correctness is separately reviewed as citation_support.
methodology.observed_measurements: Include unsuccessful attempts; known-value means report accounting coverage and do not impute missing usage or cost.
methodology.failure_aware_correctness: All 206 completed outputs have AI scores. The 19 unsuccessful attempts with no answer text receive no review and contribute zero correctness. Each condition mean covers all 45 planned and observed attempts.
methodology.pairing: Question clusters averaged across all planned repetitions; exclude a question for a metric if any planned value on either side is unavailable.
methodology.uncertainty: Seeded paired question-cluster percentile bootstrap: 15 development questions, three repetitions, 2000 samples, seed 0. Intervals are descriptive for this benchmark, without multiplicity adjustment; they do not establish held-out generalization, inter-rater reliability, equivalence or non-inferiority.
methodology.scope: Per-query measurements exclude separately recorded indexing costs. Split/category counts describe observed records; restrict the frozen job set before aggregation when reporting a particular split or category.

budget_accounting.interpretation: Used-or-reserved admission estimates; not actual billed usage.

review_provenance.authorization: User explicitly requested scoring the 206 blinded answers on November 19, 2026.
review_provenance.derivation: All CLI numeric results retained verbatim. Only methodology descriptions are corrected for AI review, the failure denominator and the 15-question development design; explicit review provenance is added.
review_provenance.timestamp_basis: Original creation time (filesystem birthtime) of each completed assessment file, using the user-approved file-creation-time convention. ISO8601 America/New_York, microsecond precision exposed by filesystem API.
review_provenance.blinding: Scores finalized without condition labels, selected strategies, aggregate results, raw traces or prior-run grades. Root used programmatic raw binding validation without displaying conditions. Answer style can reveal a strategy.
review_provenance.limitations: Single AI evaluation workflow with delegated source checks and root adjudication; no independent human review or inter-rater reliability estimate.
